                                         manual task since automated GUI testing tools target lower level          However, a recent empirical study of Android develop-
                                         adequacy metrics such as structural code coverage or activity          ers [8] reports that the primary test design strategy adopted
                                         coverage. We propose D ROIDAGENT, an autonomous GUI testing            by Android developers is to follow the usage model of the
                                         agent for Android, for semantic, intent-driven automation of           apps. Developers overwhelmingly prefer test cases that target
                                         GUI testing. It is based on Large Language Models and support
                                                                                                                individual features and use cases, which are higher level test
                                         mechanisms such as long- and short-term memory. Given an
                                         Android app, D ROIDAGENT sets relevant task goals and subse-           objectives compared to activity coverage, a structural testing
                                         quently tries to achieve them by interacting with the app. Our         objective. The emphasis on more semantic test objectives can

                                         Themis benchmark shows that it can set up and perform realistic        of automatically generated test cases that they ideally want.
                                         tasks, with a higher level of autonomy. For example, when testing
                                                                                                                Surprisingly, the most popular choice is natural language
                                         a messaging app, D ROIDAGENT created a second account and
                                         added a first account as a friend, testing a realistic use case,       rather than any test API scripts. Further, developers want
                                         without human intervention. On average, D ROIDAGENT achieved           expected outputs, as well as steps of use cases and specific

                                         the-art GUI testing techniques. Further, manual analysis shows         reveal a gap between what is being offered by automated

                                            To address the challenges in GUI testing, there has been a          the developer with both a natural language task description as

                                         various aspects of mobile GUI testing. Most of the existing            D ROIDAGENT is the first Android GUI testing technique that

                                         much as possible. For example, DroidBot [4] adopts a greedy            on sequences of identified tasks.

                                         exploration target. Humanoid [1] adopt deep learning in hope           guage Model (LLM) instances that interact and externally act
                                         to mimic human-like exploration paths by utilising pretrained          as an autonomous agent. LLMs have been used to automate
                                         models to weigh probable GUI actions, aligning them with               Android GUI testing before, but either in more limited con-
                                         frequently performed actions based on real human traces.               texts, or with much less autonomy than D ROIDAGENT. For
                                         More recently, reinforcement learning has been applied to GUI          example, Liu et al. [9] proposed an approach to generate

                                         based reward functions [5], [6], [7]. While these approaches

Fig. 9. Number of tokens for GPT-3.5/GPT-4 model input/output (log scale).               from the gallery app, share an app data via email), and start

                                                                                         prematurely terminated essential interactions in the external
                                                                                         app due to this limit. Additionally, some activities among
   Task 1: Create a new              Task 2: Create a second user                        the subject apps were exclusively triggered by external apps,
   account in the Chat App           account on the Chat App                             such as the WidgetConfiguration activity, which is only
                                                                                         accessed by an app launcher. By design, D ROIDAGENT is not
                                                                                         limited to the target app. Broadening D ROIDAGENT’s scope
                                                                                         to test functionalities of AUT across multiple apps presents a
                                                                                         promising avenue for future exploration.

                                                                                                         VIII. T HREATS TO VALIDITY

                                                                                         Internal Validity. Our study might be affected by the inher-
     Task 3: Initiate a chat with          Adaptation: Fix             Feedback: Email
     the second account created            email address               length limit      ent randomness associated with LLMs. Given the monetary
                                                                                         constraints linked to API requests, we could not conduct mul-
Fig. 10. Example of testing scenarios by D ROIDAGENT for creating multiple               tiple runs, potentially leaving biases. Additionally, one of the
accounts in a simple chat app.                                                           baselines, our version of GPTDroid, includes modifications to
                                                                                         some of its components. In our implementation, we observed
                                                                                         that the LLM context limit was reached post ten actions,
Accordingly, the present-time cost for running D ROIDAGENT
                                                                                         forcing a reset of the preceding conversation prompt, an issue
on a single application with a two-hour budget ranges between
                                                                                         not tackled in the original paper.
$13 to $22, summing up the cost from both the GPT-3.5 and
GPT-4 models, averaging $18.1. Given the trend of decreasing                             External Validity. Our study utilised a relatively limited set
cost per token charged by OpenAI, as well as the rapid                                   of benchmarks as well as underlying LLMs, and therefore
advancements of open source LLMs, we expect the cost of                                  may not generalise. We tried to use an existing benchmark
running D ROIDAGENT to be reduced and affordable.                                        of Android apps, Themis [14]. Further studies of more apps
                                                                                         and other open source LLMs are needed to address this threat.
                             VII. D ISCUSSION
  This section decribes a couple of observed behaviour of                                                      IX. C ONCLUSION
D ROIDAGENT that warrants some discussion and future work.
                                                                                            We present D ROIDAGENT, an autonomous testing agent for
A. Testing social applications                                                           Android GUI testing. Unlike existing automated GUI testing
   So far, testing of social applications that would require                             tools for Android, D ROIDAGENT sets its own meaningful tasks
multiple accounts has been considered out of scope for the                               according to the functionalities of the app under test, and
existing exploration techniques. We demonstrate the potential                            subsequently seeks to achieve them. Our empirical evaluation
of applying D ROIDAGENT on testing multi-user interactions                               of D ROIDAGENT against four baselines shows that D ROIDA-
in Figure 10, which contains testing scenarios generated by                              GENT is capable of exploring more Android activities on
D ROIDAGENT with a custom goal of “testing multiple user                                 average, despite doing so while trying to achieve meaningful
interactions”. The first account created follows the persona                             app specific tasks. D ROIDAGENT also exhibits some novel
profile, and the credentials for the second account is newly                             behaviour, such as reusing data it created earlier for later
synthesised as a variation of the persona profile. Moreover,                             interactions with the app, or creating multiple accounts to test
while creating the second account, D ROIDAGENT encounters a                              the app. We believe autonomous agents can make significant
truncated email address due to the length limit of the textfield,                        contributions to automation of GUI testing.
